source.title: Fedlex: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG, SR 641.20), Stand am 1. Januar 2024, Art. 37; ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.1

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (Quellensteuer) [federal, cantonal and communal]
rows.value: withheld by the employer at the canton's tariff; ordinary assessment on request for quasi-residents (at least 90% of worldwide income taxed in Switzerland); German commuters at most 4.5%; Italian new commuters 80% of the tariff. Paid by non-resident employees and foreign residents without a C permit (withheld by the employer). DBG art. 83-101; QStV; StHG art. 32-38; tax treaties and cross-border agreements.

source.title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 83, 91 and 99a; Fedlex: Quellensteuerverordnung des EFD (QStV, SR 642.118.2), Stand am 10. Januar 2025, Art. 1 and 14

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
rows.value: in about half the cantons, mostly communal, 0.1 per mille to 3 per mille of the gross property value; none in ZH, SZ, GL, ZG, SO, BL and AG; imputed rental value abolished from 1 January 2029 (vote of 28 September 2025). Paid by property owners. cantonal tax laws and municipal tax regulations.

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
rows.value: usually 1% to 3.3% of the purchase price; none as such in ZH, UR, SZ, GL, ZG, SH, AG and TI (fees only). Paid by the buyer unless agreed otherwise (half each in OW, BL and AR). cantonal transfer tax laws.

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

rows.label: Military levy: military service exemption tax (Wehrpflichtersatzabgabe) [national]
rows.value: CHF 3 per CHF 100 of taxable net income, at least CHF 400 a year, reduced for service days. Paid by Swiss men liable to military service who do not serve, from age 19 to 37 (collected by the cantons). Bundesgesetz über die Wehrpflichtersatzabgabe (WPEG); Art. 40 and 59 BV.
rows.note: Checklist item A2

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.1.3 Wehrpflichtersatzabgabe

rows.label: Church tax (Kirchensteuer) [regional]
rows.value: a multiple of the simple cantonal tax set by the church communities (each canton page lists the capital's Reformed and Catholic multipliers); none in VD, only in some communes of VS, voluntary for individuals in TI, NE and GE. Paid by members of the Reformed, Roman Catholic and Christian Catholic churches; in most cantons also companies (not in BS, SH, AR, SG, AG and GE; voluntary in TI and NE). cantonal tax and church laws.
rows.note: Checklist item A4

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3 Steuern der Kantone und Gemeinden (Kirchensteuer)

rows.label: Capital gains of individuals: private securities tax-free; cantonal property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) [regional]
rows.value: gains on private movable assets tax-free (federal and cantonal); gains on real estate taxed only by the cantons under a special property gains tax. Paid by sellers of real estate (and, in ZH, BE, UR, SZ, NW, BS, BL, TI and JU, companies too). DBG; StHG; cantonal property gains tax laws.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.1.8 Kapitalgewinne aus beweglichem Privatvermögen and 3.1.9 Grundstückgewinnsteuer

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and lottery winnings (Verrechnungssteuer) [national]
rows.value: 35% on dividends, interest and taxable winnings; 15% on life annuities and pensions; 8% on other insurance benefits; refunded to residents who declare, final for non-residents unless a treaty gives a refund. Paid by Swiss companies, banks and insurers withhold it from the recipient. Bundesgesetz über die Verrechnungssteuer (VStG); Art. 132 para. 2 BV.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.2.2 Verrechnungssteuer

rows.label: Rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: income from immovable assets (rents and the imputed rent of owner-occupied homes until the reform) and pensions and lump sums from pillars 1, 2 and 3a are taxable income under the federal and cantonal income taxes. Paid by resident individuals. DBG; StHG; cantonal tax laws.
rows.note: Checklist item A7

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.1.1.1 Einkommenssteuer natürlicher Personen and 3.1.2

rows.label: Employer levies: family allowance fund contributions (Familienausgleichskasse) [regional]
rows.value: 1.025% to 2.75% of wages depending on the fund; employees pay nothing (0.13% in Valais). Paid by employers. Familienzulagengesetz (FamZG) and cantonal laws.
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: family-allowances

source.title: BSV: Übersicht über die schweizerische soziale Sicherheit (Stand 1.1.2026), Familienzulagen and Finanzierung

rows.label: Local business tax: tourism promotion levy (Tourismusförderungsabgabe) [regional]
rows.value: levied in AI and GE on businesses that benefit from tourism, by benefit and value added; communes of BE, LU, GL, FR, GR, TI, VD and VS may levy a similar levy. Paid by businesses benefiting from tourism. cantonal tourism laws.
rows.note: Checklist item C2

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.2.6.2 Tourismusförderungsabgabe

rows.label: Local sales tax: none; entertainment tax in some cantons (Vergnügungssteuer) [regional]
rows.value: no cantonal or communal VAT or sales tax (VAT, customs and special consumption taxes are federal); entertainment tax usually 10% of the ticket price in FR, AR and TI (cinemas only), an optional communal tax in LU, SO, VD and NE. Paid by organisers of paid public events (passed on in ticket prices). Federal Constitution (VAT and special consumption taxes are federal); cantonal entertainment tax laws.
rows.note: Checklist item D2

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 1.4, 3.2.3 Vergnügungssteuer and 4 Übersicht

rows.label: Excise duties: tobacco, beer, spirits and mineral oil tax (besondere Verbrauchssteuern) [national]
rows.value: cigarettes 11.832 Rappen each plus 25% of the retail price; beer CHF 16.88 to 33.76 per hl; spirits CHF 29 per litre of pure alcohol (alcopops CHF 116); petrol 76.82 and diesel 79.57 Rappen per litre. Paid by manufacturers and importers (passed on to consumers). TStG; BStG; AlkG; MinöStG.
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.2.4 Besondere Verbrauchssteuern

rows.label: Securities issue and transfer tax and insurance premium tax (eidgenössische Stempelabgaben) [national]
rows.value: issue tax 1% on new participation rights (CHF 1 million allowance); transfer tax 0.15% on Swiss and 0.3% on foreign securities; 5% on insurance premiums (2.5% on single-premium life insurance). Paid by Swiss companies (issue tax), securities dealers (transfer tax) and insurers (premium tax). Bundesgesetz über die Stempelabgaben (StG).
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: financial-transaction-tax

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.2.3 Eidgenössische Stempelabgaben

rows.label: Gambling tax: casino tax (Spielbankenabgabe) [national]
rows.value: land-based casinos 40% of gross gaming revenue up to CHF 10 million, rising by 0.5% per further million to 80%; online casinos 20% up to CHF 3 million, rising in steps to 80%; cantons with B-licence casinos may levy up to 40% of the federal total. Paid by licensed casinos. Bundesgesetz über Geldspiele (BGS); Art. 106 BV.
rows.note: Checklist item D5

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.1.2 Eidgenössische Spielbankenabgabe

rows.label: Electricity grid surcharge (Netzzuschlag) [national]
rows.value: 2.3 Rappen per kWh in 2026, billed by the grid operators. Paid by electricity consumers. Energiegesetz (EnG); Energieverordnung (EnV).
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: energy-tax

source.title: ElCom: Leicht sinkende Strompreise 2026 (media release on the 2026 electricity tariffs)

rows.label: Wealth tax (Vermögenssteuer) [regional]
rows.value: levied by every canton and commune on net wealth; proportional in LU, UR, SZ, OW, NW, GL, AI, SG and TG, two or three steps in AR and BL, progressive elsewhere; each canton page has the simple tax tariff; no federal wealth tax. Paid by individuals resident in the canton. StHG; cantonal tax laws.
rows.note: Checklist item E3

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.1.4 Vermögenssteuer natürlicher Personen

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (Erbschafts- und Schenkungssteuern) [regional]
rows.value: cantonal only; none in SZ and OW, no gift tax in LU; spouses exempt everywhere; children exempt except in AI, VD, NE (and communal tax in LU); rates by relationship and amount. Paid by heirs, legatees and recipients of gifts. cantonal inheritance and gift tax laws.
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance-gift

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.1.6 Erbschafts- und Schenkungssteuern

rows.label: Vehicle taxes: automobile tax, motorway vignette and cantonal motor vehicle tax (Automobilsteuer, Nationalstrassenabgabe, Motorfahrzeugsteuer) [national]
rows.value: 4% of the value of imported cars; vignette CHF 40 a year; heavy vehicle fee 2.39 to 3.26 Rappen per tonne-km; annual cantonal motor vehicle tax set by each canton. Paid by importers, motorway users, hauliers and vehicle keepers. AStG; NSAG; SVAG; cantonal motor vehicle tax laws.
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.2.4.4 Automobilsteuer, 2.4 Verkehrsabgaben and 3.2.1 Motorfahrzeugsteuer

rows.label: CO2 levy on heating and process fuels (CO2-Abgabe) [national]
rows.value: CHF 120 per tonne of CO2 since 2022 (31.80 Rappen per litre of heating oil extra light); about two thirds redistributed. Paid by buyers of heating oil, natural gas, coal and other fossil fuels. CO2-Gesetz; CO2-Verordnung.
rows.note: Checklist item F2; detailed table: carbon-tax

source.title: BAFU: CO₂-Abgabe für Privatpersonen

rows.label: Tourist tax: overnight-stay levy (Kurtaxe / Beherbergungsabgabe) [municipal]
rows.value: set by cantons and communes per night; none in ZH and TG; optional for communes in SO, GR, AG (spa communes only) and VD. Paid by overnight guests (collected by the accommodation provider). cantonal tourism laws and communal regulations.
rows.note: Checklist item F3

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.2.6.1 Beherbergungsabgabe / Kurtaxe

rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and traveller allowances (Zollabgaben) [national]
rows.value: value allowance CHF 150 per person per day; duty-free quantities for meat, butter, oils, alcohol and tobacco; duties and import VAT up to CHF 5 not collected; mostly weight-based duties, industrial tariffs abolished in 2024; cash: no declaration, questions from CHF 10,000. Paid by importers and travellers. Zollgesetz (ZG); Zolltarifgesetz (ZTG); MWSTG.
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs

source.title: BAZG: Mehrwertsteuer: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken

rows.label: Stamp duties on documents: cantonal stamp taxes and registration duties (kantonale Stempelsteuern und Registerabgaben) [regional]
rows.value: levied in TI, VD (mortgage contracts only), VS (also on playing cards) and GE (registration duties; stamp tax abolished 1 January 2019) on official documents, filings and contracts. Paid by parties to the documents. cantonal stamp and registration laws; Art. 134 BV.
rows.note: Checklist item H1

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.2.4 Kantonale Stempelsteuer und Registerabgaben

rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee: radio and television levy (Abgabe für Radio und Fernsehen) [national]
rows.value: CHF 335 per private household per year. Paid by private households (businesses pay a turnover-based levy). federal radio and television law (RTVG).
rows.note: Checklist item H2

source.title: BAKOM: Höhe der Abgabe und Rechnungsstellung (Abgabe für Radio und Fernsehen)

rows.label: Dog tax (Hundesteuer) [municipal]
rows.value: annual tax set by the canton or commune, sometimes by the dog's size or weight; exemptions for guide, service and rescue dogs. Paid by dog owners. cantonal and communal laws.
rows.note: Checklist item H2

source.title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.2.2 Hundesteuer

rows.source_title: Informationsstelle AHV/IV: Merkblatt 2.02 Beiträge der Selbstständigerwerbenden an die AHV, die IV und die EO (Stand am 1. Januar 2026)
rows.label: Self-employed contributions: AHV/IV/EO [federal]
rows.value: 10% of earned income from CHF 60,500, sliding scale from 5.371% below that, minimum CHF 530 a year, no ceiling; plus up to 5% administrative costs and the cantonal family-allowance contribution. Paid by self-employed people (through their AHV compensation fund). AHVG; IVG; EOG; AHV leaflet 2.02.

rows.label: Contractor or employee: AHV status test [federal]
rows.value: the AHV compensation fund decides on the economic facts (own business risk, independence); no withholding on payments to resident contractors; federal withholding on fees to non-resident artists, athletes and speakers (0.8% to 7%) and board members (5%). Paid by clients who engage workers (AHV contributions where the work is employment). AHVG art. 5 and 9; BSV Wegleitung über den massgebenden Lohn; DBG art. 92 and 93.

rows.label: Simplified regimes: VAT net tax rate method and simplified settlement [federal]
rows.value: no simplified income tax; VAT registration from CHF 100,000 turnover; net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 VAT a year; 5% flat tax in the simplified settlement procedure for small wages. Paid by businesses that opt in. MWSTG art. 10 and 37; DBG art. 37a; Bundesgesetz gegen die Schwarzarbeit (BGSA).

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property

rows.source_title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 83, 91 and 99a; Fedlex: Quellensteuerverordnung des EFD (QStV, SR 642.118.2), Stand am 10. Januar 2025, Art. 1 and 14
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (Quellensteuer) [federal, cantonal and communal]
rows.value: withheld by the employer at the canton's tariff; ordinary assessment on request for quasi-residents (at least 90% of worldwide income taxed in Switzerland); German commuters at most 4.5%; Italian new commuters 80% of the tariff. Paid by non-resident employees and foreign residents without a C permit (withheld by the employer). DBG art. 83-101; QStV; StHG art. 32-38; tax treaties and cross-border agreements.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property

rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer
rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
rows.value: in about half the cantons, mostly communal, 0.1 per mille to 3 per mille of the gross property value; none in ZH, SZ, GL, ZG, SO, BL and AG; imputed rental value abolished from 1 January 2029 (vote of 28 September 2025). Paid by property owners. cantonal tax laws and municipal tax regulations.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer
rows.label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
rows.value: usually 1% to 3.3% of the purchase price; none as such in ZH, UR, SZ, GL, ZG, SH, AG and TI (fees only). Paid by the buyer unless agreed otherwise (half each in OW, BL and AR). cantonal transfer tax laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A2
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.1.3 Wehrpflichtersatzabgabe
rows.label: Military levy: military service exemption tax (Wehrpflichtersatzabgabe) [national]
rows.value: CHF 3 per CHF 100 of taxable net income, at least CHF 400 a year, reduced for service days. Paid by Swiss men liable to military service who do not serve, from age 19 to 37 (collected by the cantons). Bundesgesetz über die Wehrpflichtersatzabgabe (WPEG); Art. 40 and 59 BV.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A4
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3 Steuern der Kantone und Gemeinden (Kirchensteuer)
rows.label: Church tax (Kirchensteuer) [regional]
rows.value: a multiple of the simple cantonal tax set by the church communities (each canton page lists the capital's Reformed and Catholic multipliers); none in VD, only in some communes of VS, voluntary for individuals in TI, NE and GE. Paid by members of the Reformed, Roman Catholic and Christian Catholic churches; in most cantons also companies (not in BS, SH, AR, SG, AG and GE; voluntary in TI and NE). cantonal tax and church laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.1.8 Kapitalgewinne aus beweglichem Privatvermögen and 3.1.9 Grundstückgewinnsteuer
rows.label: Capital gains of individuals: private securities tax-free; cantonal property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) [regional]
rows.value: gains on private movable assets tax-free (federal and cantonal); gains on real estate taxed only by the cantons under a special property gains tax. Paid by sellers of real estate (and, in ZH, BE, UR, SZ, NW, BS, BL, TI and JU, companies too). DBG; StHG; cantonal property gains tax laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.2.2 Verrechnungssteuer
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and lottery winnings (Verrechnungssteuer) [national]
rows.value: 35% on dividends, interest and taxable winnings; 15% on life annuities and pensions; 8% on other insurance benefits; refunded to residents who declare, final for non-residents unless a treaty gives a refund. Paid by Swiss companies, banks and insurers withhold it from the recipient. Bundesgesetz über die Verrechnungssteuer (VStG); Art. 132 para. 2 BV.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item A7
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.1.1.1 Einkommenssteuer natürlicher Personen and 3.1.2
rows.label: Rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: income from immovable assets (rents and the imputed rent of owner-occupied homes until the reform) and pensions and lump sums from pillars 1, 2 and 3a are taxable income under the federal and cantonal income taxes. Paid by resident individuals. DBG; StHG; cantonal tax laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: family-allowances
rows.source_title: BSV: Übersicht über die schweizerische soziale Sicherheit (Stand 1.1.2026), Familienzulagen and Finanzierung
rows.label: Employer levies: family allowance fund contributions (Familienausgleichskasse) [regional]
rows.value: 1.025% to 2.75% of wages depending on the fund; employees pay nothing (0.13% in Valais). Paid by employers. Familienzulagengesetz (FamZG) and cantonal laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item C2
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.2.6.2 Tourismusförderungsabgabe
rows.label: Local business tax: tourism promotion levy (Tourismusförderungsabgabe) [regional]
rows.value: levied in AI and GE on businesses that benefit from tourism, by benefit and value added; communes of BE, LU, GL, FR, GR, TI, VD and VS may levy a similar levy. Paid by businesses benefiting from tourism. cantonal tourism laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D2
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 1.4, 3.2.3 Vergnügungssteuer and 4 Übersicht
rows.label: Local sales tax: none; entertainment tax in some cantons (Vergnügungssteuer) [regional]
rows.value: no cantonal or communal VAT or sales tax (VAT, customs and special consumption taxes are federal); entertainment tax usually 10% of the ticket price in FR, AR and TI (cinemas only), an optional communal tax in LU, SO, VD and NE. Paid by organisers of paid public events (passed on in ticket prices). Federal Constitution (VAT and special consumption taxes are federal); cantonal entertainment tax laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.2.4 Besondere Verbrauchssteuern
rows.label: Excise duties: tobacco, beer, spirits and mineral oil tax (besondere Verbrauchssteuern) [national]
rows.value: cigarettes 11.832 Rappen each plus 25% of the retail price; beer CHF 16.88 to 33.76 per hl; spirits CHF 29 per litre of pure alcohol (alcopops CHF 116); petrol 76.82 and diesel 79.57 Rappen per litre. Paid by manufacturers and importers (passed on to consumers). TStG; BStG; AlkG; MinöStG.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: financial-transaction-tax
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.2.3 Eidgenössische Stempelabgaben
rows.label: Securities issue and transfer tax and insurance premium tax (eidgenössische Stempelabgaben) [national]
rows.value: issue tax 1% on new participation rights (CHF 1 million allowance); transfer tax 0.15% on Swiss and 0.3% on foreign securities; 5% on insurance premiums (2.5% on single-premium life insurance). Paid by Swiss companies (issue tax), securities dealers (transfer tax) and insurers (premium tax). Bundesgesetz über die Stempelabgaben (StG).

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D5
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.1.2 Eidgenössische Spielbankenabgabe
rows.label: Gambling tax: casino tax (Spielbankenabgabe) [national]
rows.value: land-based casinos 40% of gross gaming revenue up to CHF 10 million, rising by 0.5% per further million to 80%; online casinos 20% up to CHF 3 million, rising in steps to 80%; cantons with B-licence casinos may levy up to 40% of the federal total. Paid by licensed casinos. Bundesgesetz über Geldspiele (BGS); Art. 106 BV.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: energy-tax
rows.source_title: ElCom: Leicht sinkende Strompreise 2026 (media release on the 2026 electricity tariffs)
rows.label: Electricity grid surcharge (Netzzuschlag) [national]
rows.value: 2.3 Rappen per kWh in 2026, billed by the grid operators. Paid by electricity consumers. Energiegesetz (EnG); Energieverordnung (EnV).

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item E3
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.1.4 Vermögenssteuer natürlicher Personen
rows.label: Wealth tax (Vermögenssteuer) [regional]
rows.value: levied by every canton and commune on net wealth; proportional in LU, UR, SZ, OW, NW, GL, AI, SG and TG, two or three steps in AR and BL, progressive elsewhere; each canton page has the simple tax tariff; no federal wealth tax. Paid by individuals resident in the canton. StHG; cantonal tax laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance-gift
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.1.6 Erbschafts- und Schenkungssteuern
rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (Erbschafts- und Schenkungssteuern) [regional]
rows.value: cantonal only; none in SZ and OW, no gift tax in LU; spouses exempt everywhere; children exempt except in AI, VD, NE (and communal tax in LU); rates by relationship and amount. Paid by heirs, legatees and recipients of gifts. cantonal inheritance and gift tax laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 2.2.4.4 Automobilsteuer, 2.4 Verkehrsabgaben and 3.2.1 Motorfahrzeugsteuer
rows.label: Vehicle taxes: automobile tax, motorway vignette and cantonal motor vehicle tax (Automobilsteuer, Nationalstrassenabgabe, Motorfahrzeugsteuer) [national]
rows.value: 4% of the value of imported cars; vignette CHF 40 a year; heavy vehicle fee 2.39 to 3.26 Rappen per tonne-km; annual cantonal motor vehicle tax set by each canton. Paid by importers, motorway users, hauliers and vehicle keepers. AStG; NSAG; SVAG; cantonal motor vehicle tax laws.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item F2; detailed table: carbon-tax
rows.source_title: BAFU: CO₂-Abgabe für Privatpersonen
rows.label: CO2 levy on heating and process fuels (CO2-Abgabe) [national]
rows.value: CHF 120 per tonne of CO2 since 2022 (31.80 Rappen per litre of heating oil extra light); about two thirds redistributed. Paid by buyers of heating oil, natural gas, coal and other fossil fuels. CO2-Gesetz; CO2-Verordnung.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item F3
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.2.6.1 Beherbergungsabgabe / Kurtaxe
rows.label: Tourist tax: overnight-stay levy (Kurtaxe / Beherbergungsabgabe) [municipal]
rows.value: set by cantons and communes per night; none in ZH and TG; optional for communes in SO, GR, AG (spa communes only) and VD. Paid by overnight guests (collected by the accommodation provider). cantonal tourism laws and communal regulations.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: BAZG: Mehrwertsteuer: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken
rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and traveller allowances (Zollabgaben) [national]
rows.value: value allowance CHF 150 per person per day; duty-free quantities for meat, butter, oils, alcohol and tobacco; duties and import VAT up to CHF 5 not collected; mostly weight-based duties, industrial tariffs abolished in 2024; cash: no declaration, questions from CHF 10,000. Paid by importers and travellers. Zollgesetz (ZG); Zolltarifgesetz (ZTG); MWSTG.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.2.4 Kantonale Stempelsteuer und Registerabgaben
rows.label: Stamp duties on documents: cantonal stamp taxes and registration duties (kantonale Stempelsteuern und Registerabgaben) [regional]
rows.value: levied in TI, VD (mortgage contracts only), VS (also on playing cards) and GE (registration duties; stamp tax abolished 1 January 2019) on official documents, filings and contracts. Paid by parties to the documents. cantonal stamp and registration laws; Art. 134 BV.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: BAKOM: Höhe der Abgabe und Rechnungsstellung (Abgabe für Radio und Fernsehen)
rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee: radio and television levy (Abgabe für Radio und Fernsehen) [national]
rows.value: CHF 335 per private household per year. Paid by private households (businesses pay a turnover-based levy). federal radio and television law (RTVG).

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: ESTV, Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026), 3.2.2 Hundesteuer
rows.label: Dog tax (Hundesteuer) [municipal]
rows.value: annual tax set by the canton or commune, sometimes by the dog's size or weight; exemptions for guide, service and rescue dogs. Paid by dog owners. cantonal and communal laws.
